## Summary

Describe the change and link any related issue (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] Added or updated unit/integration/browser tests for behavior changes
- [ ] Updated documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`) if user-visible
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run pack:check` passes
